messages:
Sara: hey everyone — two quick personal updates! i got promoted to Senior PM today 🎉 and i'm also fostering an older pup named Mochi this week. thinking of bringing Mochi to the office for the next 'bring your pet' day if that's cool — he's very chill but needs a gentle ramp to get on couches and a short walk schedule. any objections or tips?
Maya: HUGE congratulations Sara!! :tada: so happy for you. pic pls 🥹
Sam: congrats congrats!! double win. +1 on pics. when's pet day?
Sara: thanks!! woohoo. pet day usually Thursdays. was thinking Thu 4/14 around 11am in the common area. Mochi is 9 years old, mostly naps, good with people. no accidents so far.
Jordan: love this. i can bring a foldable ramp and some non-scented wipes. also happy to handle the short leash walks during lunch.
Priya: congrats Sara!! quick Q — any allergies in the office i should know about? i can bring extra anti-histamine gummies if needed 😅
Lina: i'm allergic to cats but dogs are fine for me — thanks for checking!
Maya: if Mochi is older, maybe softer treats? i can bake oat/apple dog-friendly cupcakes (no xylitol). team treat swap? :dog: :cupcake:
Sam: are we doing a tiny cake for the promotion too? i volunteer to pick up a mini cake from Oak & Crumb. chocolate-free for Mochi day obviously 😂
Priya: love a combo celebration — promo + foster = party. do we need HR signoff or any waiver?
OpsBot: [bot] Office pet policy and waiver: https://intranet.redwood/culture/pets — all visitors with animals must have signed waiver and up-to-date shot proof uploaded 24h before visit. Please submit via `/pet-visit submit` or DM People Ops.
Sara: thanks OpsBot! i'll upload Mochi's shot doc tonight. will anyone be around to supervise him near the lunch area?
Jordan: i'll be there. happy to supervise and walk.
Maya: i'll bring the cupcakes and some little 'I met Mochi' stickers for desks :)
Sam: i'll bring the non-chocolate cake and some confetti balloons (biodegradable). congrats again Sara!! :heart_eyes:
Priya: everyone ok with Thu 4/14 11am? react with :thumbsup: if yes, :thumbsdown: if no.
Lina: also — let's be mindful of folks who prefer quiet workspaces. we can keep Mochi in the common area and do a quick rotating visit so it isn't overwhelming.
Sara: perfect. thanks team. feeling very supported. will post final checklist and waiver link once uploaded. Mochi sends a sleepy paw wave 🐾
Maya: best day. congrats again!!
Sam: pics when available pls. we need content for the #pets channel 😄
Jordan: noted. i'll bring the ramp and leash. see y'all Thu!
